_comment: Tidewater issue-label palette for the Lentago Labs fleet, applied by
that repo's design-system CSS is authoritative if they ever disagree.
ensure=true   create the label if the repo lacks it, then align it.
ensure=false  align color/description ONLY where the label already
exists — used for labels that are functional on some
Labels not listed here are left completely alone: per-repo labels like
'zha' or 'phase-1' are the repo's own business, not fleet branding.
Accent discipline (BRAND.md): anther gold #E0A81C is one element per
region. 'help wanted' is the fleet's single gold label — it is the only
one that is a call to action.
